title: MPO Backs Added Routes Between Laredo and San Antonio
excerpt: Laredo's Metropolitan Planning Organization approved a resolution Wednesday backing added routes between Laredo and San Antonio, beyond Interstate 35.
content:
Laredo's Metropolitan Planning Organization approved a resolution on Wednesday, Nov. 18, backing added routes between Laredo and San Antonio.

Interstate 35 is currently the only main road out of Laredo, and the resolution says the added routes would improve mobility and connectivity along the I-35 corridor.

The resolution will be submitted as public comment in an ongoing I-35 study.

The announcement did not name any specific routes, give cost estimates, or say when a new route could be built.
